checks.text: The page displays the heading "Breathing Exercise" and the text "Select a pattern to begin".
Clicking the button labelled "Box Breathing" changes the display to show the phase "Inhale" and the countdown "4" in the BigClock component; the ProgressRing shows 0% progress.

Clicking the button labelled "Start" begins the timer; after 4 seconds, the phase text changes to "Hold" and the countdown shows "4"; after another 4 seconds, the phase changes to "Exhale" and the countdown shows "4".
After completing one full cycle (12 seconds total), the text "Cycles: 1" appears below the ProgressRing, and the ProgressRing shows 100% progress before resetting to 0% for the next cycle.
Clicking the button labelled "Pause" stops the countdown; the countdown value remains static (e.g., "2" if paused mid-phase) and the button label changes to "Resume".
Clicking the button labelled "Resume" continues the countdown from the paused value; if paused at "2" in "Inhale", it counts down to "1", "0", then switches to "Hold" with "4".
Clicking the button labelled "Reset" sets the phase to "Ready", the countdown to "0", the text "Cycles: 0", and the ProgressRing to 0%.
Selecting the pattern "4-7-8 Breathing" and clicking "Start" shows the phase "Inhale" with countdown "4"; after 4 seconds, the phase changes to "Hold" with countdown "7".
Reload keeps the selected pattern "Box Breathing" and the cycle count "Cycles: 2" if the user had completed two cycles before reloading.
